question_text: The auditor recommended that the municipal treasurer ___ the financial records.

hint_ladder.title: The Secret Signal Phrase
hint_ladder.text: 'Recommended that' is a subjunctive trigger. Think of it as a code that forces the next verb into its most basic form, no matter who does it.

hint_ladder.title: Ignore the Subject
hint_ladder.text: Even though 'treasurer' seems third-person singular, the subjunctive doesn't care. It's like a blank form that says: no -s, no -ed, no -ing.

hint_ladder.title: Spot the Plain Verb
hint_ladder.text: Among the choices, 'amend' is the only naked verb. The others have endings that break the subjunctive rule. Choose the one with zero add-ons.

hint_ladder.title: Final Check: Subjunctive Test
hint_ladder.text: Replace 'recommended that' with 'suggest that' or 'demand that' – the verb should still be 'amend'. If it works, you have the right answer.

A.text: Correct. 'Recommended that' always takes the base verb form 'amend' due to the subjunctive mood.

B.text: You might have chosen B because 'amends' matches singular 'treasurer', but subjunctive overrides subject-verb agreement.

C.text: You might have chosen C thinking past tense is needed, but subjunctive ignores the main verb's tense.

D.text: You might have chosen D seeing an ongoing action, but subjunctive demands the simplest verb form, not -ing.

next_time_rule: After 'recommend that', 'suggest that', etc., use the base verb. No -s, -ed, -ing. Just the plain dictionary form.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nasa loob ka ng barangay hall; pinag-uusapan ang budget report. Sabi ng auditor, 'I recommend that the treasurer amend the records.' Ang magic dito ay yung pariralang 'recommend that'.

'Recommend that' ay subjunctive trigger — yung verb na susunod, kahit sino pa ang subject, base form lang. Kaya maski 'treasurer' parang singular, hindi pwedeng 'amends'; kahit past tense na 'recommended', hindi pwedeng 'amended'.

Taglish Mnemonic: Isipin mo si Kuya na sobrang strict sa rules — kapag narinig niya 'recommend that', sasabihin niya, "Base form lang, 'tol! Walang dagdag, walang bawas."
